name: lenfon-marketplace
description: lenfon 的个人本地用户市场：以 directory 型固化在本机，内容不会被远程同步覆盖。当前收录 WPF/.NET 桌面开发技能——material-design-styles（MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit 样式参考与控件选型指南）、wpf-basic-template（Prism 9 + Material Design 5 标准化 WPF 脚手架），并持续扩充。
description_en: lenfon's personal local user marketplace, persisted as a directory on this machine and never overwritten by remote sync. Currently hosts WPF/.NET desktop development skills — material-design-styles (MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit style reference & control pick guide) and wpf-basic-template (standardized WPF scaffold with Prism 9 + Material Design 5) — and keeps growing.
